SELECT 
	documentcode = 'SV-' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(S.SaleInvCode, 10))), 
	TransType = 'S',
	InvDate=S.Date, 
	InvCode = S.SaleInvCode,
	CustomerAlias = A.AliasName,
	CustomerName = A.Name,
	ItemAlias = I.CustomICode,
	ItemName = I.Name,
	Qty = Sum(D.LooseQty),
	Bonus = SUM(D.BonusQty),
	Rate = D.SalePrice,
	ItemFlatDisc=D.ItemFlatDisc,
	ItemDiscPerc=D.DiscPerc,
	InvDiscPerc=S.DiscPerc,
	SalesPerson=SM.Name,
	AreaName = AR.Name
FROM
	SaleLedger S, SaleDetail D, Item I, Accounts A, Customer C, SalesMan SM, Area AR
WHERE
	S.SaleInvCode = D.SaleInvCode AND
	S.Date >= :adt_startdate AND S.Date <= :adt_enddate AND
	S.Posted IN (:as_posted) AND
	S.SManCode IN (:ai_salesmancode) AND
	S.CustCode = A.AccCode AND
	A.AccCode = C.CustCode AND
	C.AreaCode IN (:ai_areacode) AND
	C.AreaCode = AR.AreaCode AND
	S.SManCode = SM.SalesManCode AND
	D.ICode = I.ICode AND
	I.Active = 1
GROUP BY
	S.SaleInvCode,
	AR.Name,
	S.Date,
	SM.Name,
	S.DiscPerc,
	A.AliasName,
	A.Name,
	I.CustomICode,
	I.Name,
	D.SalePrice,
	D.ItemFlatDisc,
	D.DiscPerc
UNION ALL
SELECT 
	documentcode = 'SV-' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(S.SaleInvCode, 10))), 
	TransType = 'S',
	InvDate=S.Date,
	InvCode = S.SaleInvCode,
	CustomerAlias = A.AliasName,
	CustomerName = A.Name,
	ItemAlias = I.CustomICode,
	ItemName = I.Name,
	Qty = Sum(D.LooseQty),
	Bonus = SUM(D.BonusQty),
	Rate = D.SalePrice,
	ItemFlatDisc=D.ItemFlatDisc,
	ItemDiscPerc=D.DiscPerc,
	InvDiscPerc=S.DiscPerc,
	SalesPerson=SM.Name,
	AreaName = AR.Name
FROM
	SaleLedger S, SaleInvDetail D, Item I, Accounts A, Customer C, SalesMan SM, Area AR
WHERE
	S.impactinventory = 'N' AND
	S.SaleInvCode = D.SaleInvCode AND
	S.Date >= :adt_startdate AND S.Date <= :adt_enddate AND
	S.Posted IN (:as_posted) AND
	S.SManCode IN (:ai_salesmancode) AND
	S.CustCode = A.AccCode AND
	A.AccCode = C.CustCode AND
	C.AreaCode IN (:ai_areacode) AND
	C.AreaCode = AR.AreaCode AND
	S.SManCode = SM.SalesManCode AND
	D.ICode = I.ICode AND
	I.Active = 1
GROUP BY
	S.SaleInvCode,
	AR.Name,
	S.Date,
	SM.Name,
	S.DiscPerc,
	A.AliasName,
	A.Name,
	I.CustomICode,
	I.Name,
	D.SalePrice,
	D.ItemFlatDisc,
	D.DiscPerc
UNION ALL
SELECT
	documentcode = 'SR-' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(S.SRInvCode, 10))), 
	TransType = 'R',
	InvDate=S.Date,
	InvCode = S.SRInvCode,
	CustomerAlias = A.AliasName,
	CustomerName = A.Name,
	ItemAlias = I.CustomICode,
	ItemName = I.Name,
	Qty = -Sum(D.LooseQty),
	Bonus = -SUM(D.BonusQty),
	Rate = D.SRPrice,
	ItemFlatDisc=0.00,
	ItemDiscPerc=D.DiscPerc,
	InvDiscPerc=S.DiscPerc,
	SalesPerson=SM.Name,
	AreaName = AR.Name
FROM
	SRLedger S, SRDetail D, Item I, Accounts A, Customer C, SalesMan SM, Area AR
WHERE
	S.SRInvCode = D.SRInvCode AND
	S.Date >= :adt_startdate AND S.Date <= :adt_enddate AND
	S.Posted IN (:as_posted) AND
	S.SManCode IN (:ai_salesmancode) AND
	S.CustCode = A.AccCode AND
	A.AccCode = C.CustCode AND
	C.AreaCode IN (:ai_areacode) AND
	C.AreaCode = AR.AreaCode AND
	S.SManCode = SM.SalesManCode AND
	D.ICode = I.ICode AND
	I.Active = 1
GROUP BY
	S.SRInvCode,
	AR.Name,
	S.Date,
	SM.Name,
	S.DiscPerc,
	A.AliasName,
	A.Name,
	I.CustomICode,
	I.Name,
	D.SRPrice,
	D.DiscPerc
ORDER BY
	SalesPerson,
	AreaName,
	TransType,
	InvCode,
	INVDATE,
	CustomerName,
	ItemName
